text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a weird billing spike on a canary swap. provisional token credits stuck even after client reconnect + toolcall truncation :eyes:

maria: Ugh. Do you have a concrete repro or trace id?

alex: Repro is small. Sequence: client opens streaming -> router routes to canary model -> in-flight toolcall triggers truncation (toolcall TTL) -> router rolls forward swap to stable -> client reconnects and resumes against stable. Both sides got provisional token counts; router and ledger didn’t dedupe overlap.

tina: That sounds like a session metadata loss during the handoff. Are we losing session id/seq when we re-route?

alex: Yep. Router spans two hops and we were only forwarding request headers partially. model-worker accepted a new ephemeral session id for resume, ledger credited both sessions.

sam: For quick mitigation can we: 1) ensure router forwards X-RW-Session and X-RW-Seq to model-worker, 2) mark toolcalls with parent-session id, 3) treat provisional credits as reversible until finalization/EOF?

tina: I like that. Also we should add an incremental checkpoint API so workers emit small finalizable checkpoints (e.g., every N tokens) that the ledger can atomically advance. The ledger would only flip provisional->confirmed when it sees a final checkpoint or explicit EOF. That avoids double-charge on reconnect.

alex: Proposed minimal header + checkpoint payload (example):

```
X-RW-Session: rw-sess-42
X-RW-Seq: 159
X-RW-Parent: rw-sess-41  # optional for toolcalls

POST /checkpoint
{ "session": "rw-sess-42", "seq": 159, "confirmed_tokens": 412 }
```

alex: Router needs to copy X-RW-Session through to all downstream hops. If missing, model-workers should try to reconcile using parent metadata in toolcall envelope.

tina: Edge-case: ephemeral toolcalls that TTL out produce truncated outputs and sometimes spawn client reconnects mid-output. Toolcall child sessions must carry parent checksum + token-window so ledger can subtract overlap. Otherwise both parent and child get charged.

sam: For console UX: show provisional vs confirmed tokens per request/session in the request detail pane. Add a "reconcile" action that triggers a ledger resync for a session (run heuristics + accept server checkpoint). Ops can hit it when we detect anomalies.

maria: Can we also add a metric and dashboard: session_finalization_lag (time between last provisional checkpoint and finalization). Alert if > 30s for >5% of sessions in a minute. That should catch canary-induced re-route regressions.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: just rolled a tiny change to router to always forward X-RW-Session/X-RW-Seq to model-worker (canary -> 10% traffic).

alex: Nice. I'll open a short RFC/PR with: header spec, checkpoint endpoint, ledger semantics (provisional -> confirmed on checkpoint/EOF), and console mocks for provisional/confirmed tokens. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1234 (draft) :thumbsup:

tina: Thanks — assigning to infra + billing to triage next sprint. Meeting to sync tomorrow 10am.

maria: Added alert dashboard ticket to backlog. Thanks everyone.
